lines.text: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra read the Law aloud from daybreak until noon in the square before the Water Gate.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform, and when he opened the book, all the people sat down.
The Levites explained the Law, and the people wept, but Nehemiah told them to eat, drink, and send out portions.
On the second day, the family heads studied the Law and found that they should make booths from branches brought from the Jordan valley.

wrong_details.wrong: branches brought from the Jordan valley
wrong_details.true: branches brought from the hill country

lines.text: The assembly lived in booths and rejoiced greatly, and Ezra read the Law every day of the seven-day feast.
